title: Pinned enlarged etale face ringed total model
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $Z$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $W:(\Delta_{\mathrm{inj}})^{\mathrm{op}}\to \mathrm{Over}(Z)$ an augmented semisimplicial algebraic space. A pinned enlarged face ringed total model uses the actual enlarged etale sites [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model] in the AsSmall presentation, their actual chartwise-etale jointly-surjective covering families, and the explicit ULift of their extended commutative regular-function sheaves to universe $u+1$. Its coherent contravariant pseudofunctor has the actual enlargedBaseChange transitions and exactly the projection-preserving enlargedIdentityIso and enlargedCompositionIso [lem-trf-space-enlarged-ringed-composition-localization]. The ring presheaf on its Grothendieck total category restricts to those rings on each fibre and along each Cartesian lift restricts by the unique chart-normalized structural ring map. Supply its total sheaf condition and the normalized Presentation of [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category]. The base is literally the same enlarged ringed model of $Z$. Its coherent Augmentation has direct image given on all objects and morphisms by enlarged base-change precomposition, structural ring map equal to the lifted chart-normalized map, and composition comparisons the adjunction mates of exactly enlargedDirectCompositionIso, induced by the projection-preserving site compositor. Supply the normalized AugmentationPresentation of that dependency. The component module equivalence is induced only by equality of the entire ringed fibre site; it is not additional chosen data. All coherences, ring maps and augmentation maps are retained; no flatness, hypercover, quasi-coherence, or nonemptiness is part of the definition.
